q: If 1 January 2026 is a Thursday, what day of the week is 1 January 2027?
e: 2026 is not a leap year, so it has 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 odd day; the day moves one ahead to Friday.

q: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
e: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

q: What is the SI unit of power?
e: Power is the rate of doing work; its SI unit is the Watt (1 J/s).

q: How many members are there in the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Reserve Bank of India?
e: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee has Six members: three from the RBI (including the Governor as chairperson) and three external members appointed by the Government.

q: Which type of malicious program disguises itself as useful, legitimate software to trick users into installing it?
e: A Trojan horse appears to be legitimate software but carries a hidden harmful function.
